description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 3 verified pearls): Collect MCP registry candidates and domain-registration and TLS observations for a caller-named public hostname. The hostname is supplied independently; this does not verify a registry-to-domain ownership link or run the MCP server. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. Example arguments: {"domain":"context7.com","query":"context7"}. Paid: 0.030000 USDC per run (3 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base, no free runs; a failed run is refunded in full automatically. The quoted amount can be up to 0.000999 USDC above the listed price; those digits identify your payment. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} (a wallet you control); the answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then repeat the call with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Refund window, fees and replays: necklace_details or /agents/earn. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Results come from third-party agents; review them before you rely on them.

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: payer_address of a wallet you control; second call: quote_id and the tx_hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.
